gold_candidate.label: Metastatic melanoma
for: history of a 5 mm‐thick melanoma on his posterior neck
treated six years earlier by wide local excision
against: Molecular studies were negative for an EWSR1 translocation but otherwise were interpreted as consistent with Ewing sarcoma/primitive neuroectodermal tumor (PNET)

champion_candidate.label: Ewing sarcoma
for: Endobronchial ultrasound–guided fine-needle aspiration of the lung lesion demonstrated a malignant small round blue cell tumor
Molecular studies were negative for an EWSR1 translocation but otherwise were interpreted as consistent with Ewing sarcoma/primitive neuroectodermal tumor (PNET)
against: Mid-treatment PET/CT demonstrated a substantial decrease in size and complete metabolic response of the lung mass but development of right neck adenopathy and interval growth of the hyoid bone lesion, suggesting a distinct pathology
